---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem. e.g. "I always have to [...]
and it's annoying when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. Keep it concrete — which window, which setting,
which behavior.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about, including
workarounds you use today.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or links to similar features in other tools. Note that
this project is intentionally small and unaffiliated — suggestions that
would require changing the `CLIENT_ID` or borrowing Stockbit/Discord branding
are unlikely to be accepted.
